content: The player chooses: Ask Odran what the roads are like.

{"narration": "Odran does not stop repacking the cart while he answers. His hands go on with it, strap and buckle, strap and buckle, and the wet canvas smells of somebody else's rain. \"Coldharrow way is shut,\" he says. \"Has been since the frost broke.\" He tips his chin at a crate without looking up. There is a dark rime along the banding where the iron has gone grey-green instead of black. \"Drovers say it's the wet. Drovers say a lot of things.\" A horse shifts in its traces.", "choices": [{"id": "a", "text": "Look closer at the banding", "hint": "unknown"}, {"id": "b", "text": "Offer to help him load", "hint": "safe"}, {"id": "c", "text": "Ask what else the drovers say", "hint": "safe"}], "npc_voices": [{"npc_id": "npc_odran", "line": "Coldharrow way is shut."}], "ledger_delta": {"facts": [{"text": "The Coldharrow road has been shut since the frost broke.", "subject_id": "npc_odran"}]}, "mood": "uneasy"}

MECHANICAL RESULTS -- AUTHORITATIVE. Narrate these outcomes.
- stealth (standard): d20 6, +2 agility, -3 exhausted = 5 vs DC 13. FAILURE by 8.
The player chooses: Slip past the salt-house at Harrowmere.

{"narration": "You are more tired than you let yourself think. The gravel gives under your heel with a sound like a small bone breaking, and Ilya's lantern swings round before you have finished flinching. He is not alarmed. That is somehow worse. \"Bit late to be walking,\" he says, and waits, and the waiting goes on long enough that you understand you are being counted.", "choices": [{"id": "a", "text": "Give him a name", "hint": "risky"}, {"id": "b", "text": "Turn back the way you came", "hint": "safe"}, {"id": "c", "text": "Pay him for the trouble", "hint": "costly"}], "npc_voices": [{"npc_id": "npc_ilya", "line": "Bit late to be walking."}], "ledger_delta": {"npc_disposition": {"npc_ilya": -2}}, "mood": "tense"}
